title: Multi-Currency Sub-Account Inclusion (USD, EUR, GBP in One Group)
precondition: Master account denominated in USD; sub-accounts in USD, EUR, and GBP.
steps: 1. Link EUR account (€10,000) and GBP account (£10,000).
expected_result: Sizing engine converts sub-account balances to USD base using live broker spot FX rates for accurate proportional weighting.
actual_result: Funds API dynamically converts multi-currency cash balances to master base currency for proportional sizing.
